{"id":"a41f6c0e-ai-native-definition","title":"Definition: AI-native customer","last_edited_time":"2026-07-28T18:42:00Z","markdown":"# Definition: AI-native customer

An account is **AI-native** when machine learning or foundation models are in the critical path of the product it sells to its own customers. Using ML internally (forecasting, analytics, support bots) does not make an account AI-native.

GTM reviews every enterprise account against this definition and records the decision in the **Enterprise account review** database. That database is the source of truth.

Accounts that have not been reviewed yet show *Not reviewed*; their reviews are run as issues in Linear by the GTM team until the database is updated.
"}

name: notion_get_page
result:
{"id":"3b8d04f1-revenue-conventions","title":"Revenue reporting conventions","last_edited_time":"2026-08-14T09:05:00Z","markdown":"# Revenue reporting conventions

Applies to every revenue number that leaves the finance team.

1. **Revenue is net.** Sum `amount_usd` over all invoice lines, charges and credits together. Credits are negative lines with `line_type = 'credit'`.
2. **Exclude internal accounts.** Test and demo accounts are billed like customers so we can exercise invoicing, but they are not revenue. Exclude any customer whose domain ends in `.internal`.
3. **Services are reported separately.** SUP-PREM and ONB-PRO roll up to a single *Services* line, never to a product.
4. **Segments come from billing.** Use the `segment` column on the customers table; do not re-derive it from ARR.
5. Fiscal year is the calendar year.
"}

{"id":"7c1e9a52-catalog","title":"Product catalog","last_edited_time":"2026-09-02T16:20:00Z","markdown":"# Product catalog

Fieldstone sells four products. Every invoice line carries a SKU; this page is the source of truth for which product a SKU belongs to.

| Product | SKU | Billing unit |
|---|---|---|
| Pulse (observability) | PUL-STD | per host, standard tier |
| Pulse (observability) | PUL-ENT | per host, enterprise tier |
| Vault (managed storage) | VLT-STORE | per TB-month |
| Vault (managed storage) | VLT-BACKUP | per TB-month of backups |
| Relay (event streaming) | RLY-MSG | per million messages |
| Relay (event streaming) | RLY-CONN | per managed connector |
| Forge (ML pipelines) | FRG-GPU | per GPU-hour |
| Forge (ML pipelines) | FRG-SEAT | per seat |

## Not products

- SUP-PREM (premium support) and ONB-PRO (professional onboarding) are services. See *Revenue reporting conventions*.

## Retired SKUs

- STRM-LEGACY: the pre-2025 streaming plan. Retired from new sales in March 2026; existing contracts still bill it. Reporting treatment is tracked in Linear (BILL-118).
"}

args.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN domain IN ('latticelabs.ai','synthex.ai','corticalsystems.com','mosaicvision.io','parrotspeech.ai','quill.law','inferenceworks.dev','heliorobotics.com','embersearch.ai','cobaltsec.com','helixbio.com','nimbushealth.com') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ai
  FROM 'gs://your-bucket/data-agent/customers.parquet'
  WHERE segment='enterprise' AND domain NOT LIKE '%.internal'
), l AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN sku IN ('PUL-STD','PUL-ENT') THEN 'Pulse' WHEN sku IN ('VLT-STORE','VLT-BACKUP') THEN 'Vault' WHEN sku IN ('RLY-MSG','RLY-CONN','STRM-LEGACY') THEN 'Relay' WHEN sku IN ('FRG-GPU','FRG-SEAT') THEN 'Forge' WHEN sku IN ('SUP-PREM','ONB-PRO') THEN 'Services' ELSE 'UNMAPPED' END product, customer_id, amount_usd
  FROM 'gs://your-bucket/data-agent/invoice_lines.parquet')
SELECT l.product, round(sum(CASE WHEN c.ai=1 THEN l.amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) ai_native_usd, round(sum(CASE WHEN c.ai=0 THEN l.amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) not_ai_native_usd
FROM l JOIN c ON l.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY l.product ORDER BY l.product

assumptions: Revenue is net: charges and credits summed (Notion: Revenue reporting conventions, rule 1).
Excluded customers whose domain ends in .internal (2 enterprise test/demo accounts) (Revenue reporting conventions, rule 2).
Enterprise = segment column on customers table, not re-derived from ARR (Revenue reporting conventions, rule 4).
SKU to product mapping from Notion Product catalog; SUP-PREM and ONB-PRO are rolled into a separate Services line, not a product (Revenue reporting conventions rule 3, Product catalog).
STRM-LEGACY counted as Relay for all revenue reporting (Linear BILL-118, overriding the catalog's 'retired' listing).
AI-native flags come from the Notion Enterprise account review database (source of truth per the 'Definition: AI-native customer' page): 10 accounts marked Yes.
Three accounts marked 'Not reviewed' were resolved from Linear GTM-214: Helix Bio = AI-native, Nimbus Health = AI-native, Granite Logistics = not AI-native.
No date filter applied, so all invoice history is included (fiscal year = calendar year, but no period was requested).

WITH c AS (
  SELECT customer_id, CASE WHEN domain IN ('latticelabs.ai','synthex.ai','corticalsystems.com','mosaicvision.io','parrotspeech.ai','quill.law','inferenceworks.dev','heliorobotics.com','embersearch.ai','cobaltsec.com','helixbio.com','nimbushealth.com') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ai
  FROM 'gs://your-bucket/data-agent/customers.parquet'
  WHERE segment='enterprise' AND domain NOT LIKE '%.internal'
), l AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN sku IN ('PUL-STD','PUL-ENT') THEN 'Pulse' WHEN sku IN ('VLT-STORE','VLT-BACKUP') THEN 'Vault' WHEN sku IN ('RLY-MSG','RLY-CONN','STRM-LEGACY') THEN 'Relay' WHEN sku IN ('FRG-GPU','FRG-SEAT') THEN 'Forge' WHEN sku IN ('SUP-PREM','ONB-PRO') THEN 'Services' ELSE 'UNMAPPED' END product, customer_id, amount_usd
  FROM 'gs://your-bucket/data-agent/invoice_lines.parquet')
SELECT l.product, round(sum(CASE WHEN c.ai=1 THEN l.amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) ai_native_usd, round(sum(CASE WHEN c.ai=0 THEN l.amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) not_ai_native_usd
FROM l JOIN c ON l.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY l.product ORDER BY l.product
summary: Net revenue for the 28 real enterprise accounts, by product, split by AI-native status. Forge is the largest line for AI-native accounts ($3.60M vs $1.35M for the others). Services is shown separately and is not a product.
